{{Top|leg}}
'''Space Skeets''' was a recreational activity aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> Situated on the [[Recreation Deck]],<ref name="ROTM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> passengers could use miniature [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to shoot [[Skeet/Legends|skeets]] launched from the ship.<ref name="RPG" /> Each skeet booth was protected by an independent environment membrane, and passengers used a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to trigger the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled skeet release.<ref name="ROTM" />
